name: group_oscore_key
description: Group OSCORE key distribution per spec Section 18.6. Pairwise wrapped, key_epoch, 1hr grace.

vectors.name: key_pairwise_wrap
vectors.description: Group key is wrapped pairwise for each member using their pubkey.

vectors.name: key_epoch_increment
vectors.description: key_epoch increments on each rekey (monotonic u32).

vectors.name: key_epoch_oscore_context
vectors.description: key_epoch is included in OSCORE id_context for context isolation.

vectors.name: grace_period_1hr
vectors.description: Old key remains valid for 1hr after rekey (grace period).

vectors.name: grace_period_expired
vectors.description: Old key rejected after 1hr grace period.

vectors.name: epoch_rollback_reject
vectors.description: Message with epoch < current is rejected (prevents replay).

vectors.name: epoch_future_reject
vectors.description: Message with epoch > current+1 is rejected (unknown key).

vectors.name: rekey_distribution_to_all
vectors.description: On rekey, all current members receive wrapped new key.

vectors.name: member_removal_no_rekey_access
vectors.description: Removed member does not receive new key material.

vectors.name: new_member_no_old_key
vectors.description: New member only receives current key, not historical.
